import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')
from run import show

def doc(cases, events, channels, defs=None, timeout=100):
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":defs or [],"timeout_ms":timeout,"cases":cases,"events":events,"channels":channels}

c1 = {"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],
      "expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}

# chunked body
ch = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n5\r\nhello\r\n0\r\nX-T: v\r\n\r\n"}]}]
show('chunked', doc([c1],[],[ch]))

# two requests, second owned by nobody
ch2 = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"},{"case":None,"data":"GET /y HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"}]}]
show('two requests', doc([c1],[],[ch2]))

# syntax error
ch3 = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost h.example\r\n\r\n"}]}]
show('bad header', doc([c1],[],[ch3]))

# incomplete
ch4 = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.exa"}]}]
show('incomplete', doc([c1],[],[ch4]))

# mixed owner
ch5 = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n"},{"case":None,"data":"\r\n"}]}]
show('mixed owner', doc([c1],[],[ch5]))

# identity mismatch + multiple host
ch6 = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /z HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: other.example\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"}]}]
show('identity/multiple host', doc([c1],[],[ch6]))

# extra request for the same owner
ch7 = [{"name":"edge","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\nGET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"}]}]
show('extra', doc([c1],[],[ch7]))
PYEOF
